description: Offline reference of common Unity shader properties: conventional names, declared types, the surface slot they feed, and the pipelines that expose them. Authored fresh for OAC; verify exact names and defaults against the Unity ShaderLab manual and the active render pipeline package for the editor version in use. Read-only, no Editor required.

propertyTypes.summary: RGBA colour, authored as four floats or a hex value; often paired with a texture.
Four floats; the fourth is commonly unused (xyz) or a scalar multiplier.
Single float exposed as a slider or numeric field.
Float constrained to an inspector slider between a and b.
Standard 2D texture with a matching sampler; UV tiling and offset per material.
Cubemap texture used for reflections and sky sampling.
Volume texture used for lookup or noise fields.

entries.summary: URP/HDRP base colour texture. Built-in equivalents use _MainTex.
Tint multiplied into the base map. Built-in equivalent is _Color.
Built-in pipeline main texture slot.
Built-in pipeline main colour tint.
Tangent-space normal map; the sampled value is unpacked before use.
HDRP normal map slot; HDRP also exposes separate detail normal slots.
Scales the normal map influence; 1 is neutral.
Metallic workflow control; pair with a metallic/smoothness map for variation.
Microsurface smoothness; the inverse of roughness.
Packed metallic (red) and smoothness (alpha) map.
AO map sampled into the green channel; strength controlled by _OcclusionStrength.
Blends between full AO and no AO.
Emissive texture; enable the emission keyword for it to contribute.
Emissive tint; HDR intensity is carried in the colour alpha via an HDR colour picker.
Alpha threshold used when alpha clipping is enabled.
HDRP keyword toggle for alpha clipping.
URP lit material switch: 0 opaque, 1 transparent. Requires material validation and per-material keywords.
URP transparent blend switch: 0 alpha, 1 premultiply, 2 additive, 3 multiply.
0 off, 1 front, 2 back. Commonly overridden in a second pass for outlines.
Depth buffer write toggle; usually off for transparent materials.
Offsets the material within its render queue to resolve sorting ties.
HDRP detail map blended over the base albedo at close range.
Conventional name for a dissolve threshold driven by a noise texture. Custom property; author and expose it yourself.
Conventional name for an outline tint. Custom property; usually paired with _OutlineWidth.
Conventional name for outline thickness in object or clip space. Custom property.
Conventional exponent for a view-angle (fresnel) rim term. Custom property.
Conventional name for rim-light tint. Custom property.
Conventional name for vertex-displacement amplitude. Custom property.
Conventional name for scanline scroll speed in a hologram-style shader. Custom property.
